news.title: Introducing the new Copilot with Home, Code and Autopilot
news.summary_raw:
We’re reimagining Microsoft Copilot to enable work as it evolves and to help expand what every individual and every organization can accomplish in the flow of human ambition. Today we’re introducing the new Copilot to connect the tools people rely on with the next generation of capabilities they’ll need to build, customize and scale AI...
The post Introducing the new Copilot with Home, Code and Autopilot appeared first on The Official Microsoft Blog.
news.summary: Microsoft has launched an updated Copilot suite that integrates Home, Code, and Autopilot, embedding advanced AI capabilities directly into the tools used across organizations. This release expands Copilot’s functionality beyond chat to include code generation, workflow automation, and dynamic AI assistance within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Go to the Microsoft 365 Admin Center and enable the new Copilot settings under the 'AI & Automation' blade this week. S2: Without enabling these features, your team will miss out on automated code reviews, policy enforcement, and streamlined onboarding workflows, which could increase support tickets and compliance risk. S3: The most affected tool is Microsoft 365 (including Teams, SharePoint, and Power Platform) where the new Copilot can directly optimize user productivity and reduce IT overhead.

news.title: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar
news.summary: Google DeepMind has unveiled Gemini 3.8 Live, a new AI model featuring real‑time live avatar capabilities for dynamic, interactive conversations. This update brings advanced multimodal interaction to Google’s suite, potentially impacting Workspace and enterprise collaboration tools.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Enable the Gemini 3.8 Live feature in the Google Workspace Admin Console under AI Settings this week. S2: Failing to adopt this could leave your organization behind competitors who can offer immersive, AI‑powered user experiences and reduce support ticket volume. S3: The most relevant tool is Google Workspace, but integration with JumpCloud and Freshservice will be necessary for unified identity and ITSM workflows.

news.title: New Microsoft data innovations unlock what only your business knows
news.summary_raw:
Every organization has knowledge that is uniquely its own: the way its business operates, the data it has built over time, the expertise of its people and the context behind thousands of everyday decisions. As powerful AI models become more widely available, that unique business intelligence matters more than ever. The difference will come from...

news.summary: Microsoft has announced new data‑centric AI innovations that enable organizations to unlock insights unique to their own business knowledge. These capabilities are designed to work across the Microsoft ecosystem, including Azure and Microsoft 365.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Check Microsoft 365’s new AI‑powered data analytics features in the Admin Center this week and run a pilot on a small data set. S2: Not doing so could mean missing early advantages in data‑driven decision making and lagging competitors who adopt faster. news.title: Advancing Private AI Compute with secure, server-side memory
news.summary_raw: Introducing private, server-side memory to Private AI Compute for personal AI.
news.summary: Google DeepMind has unveiled Private AI Compute with a secure, server‑side memory feature, allowing personal AI applications to operate with enhanced data privacy. This development signals a shift toward more secure on‑premises AI workloads, potentially influencing future integration with Google Workspace and related security tooling.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Review the Private AI Compute documentation and assess how the server‑side memory could be leveraged for secure internal AI use cases or for integrating with your existing MDM and SSO frameworks. S2: Not adopting these capabilities might leave your organization trailing competitors who can offer more robust AI privacy controls. S3: Focus on Google Workspace and Cloud Identity as the most directly affected tools, ensuring any new integrations remain compliant with your security policies.

news.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
news.summary_raw: Meet GPT-6.1 Sol: near-Astra intelligence for coding, computer use, and professional work at one-fifth of Astra’s standard API input and output token prices.
news.summary: OpenAI has announced GPT‑6.1 Sol, a new model offering near‑Astra level intelligence for coding and professional tasks at significantly lower API token costs. The release highlights a substantial price reduction that could make advanced language models more economically viable for enterprise workloads.
news.enterprise_use: Monitor OpenAI’s pricing tiers for GPT‑6.1 Sol and evaluate whether the lower token costs justify migrating existing AI workloads from GPT‑4 or other models to this new offering. Assess the impact on your budget and potential for scaling AI-driven automation in support tickets or policy scripting. If cost savings align with your usage patterns, consider updating your API integration to incorporate GPT‑6.1 Sol for future projects.

news.title: How Diffusion Controller unifies and simplifies AI image generation
news.summary_raw: Algorithms & Theory
news.summary: Google AI’s new Diffusion Controller streamlines AI image generation by unifying multiple diffusion models into a single, more efficient workflow. This enables faster, more consistent image output across varied use cases.
news.enterprise_use: Monitor Google AI’s diffusion model releases over the next 30 days and evaluate whether the unified controller can accelerate your internal content creation or support staff training workflows. Keeping an eye on the API updates will help you decide if integration is feasible without disrupting existing tooling.

news.title: Automating coherent long-form video generation
news.summary_raw: Generative AI
news.summary: Google AI has unveiled an automated system capable of generating coherent long‑form videos from textual prompts. This new feature leverages generative models to produce polished video content at scale.
news.enterprise_use: Monitor the release to assess its integration potential with Google Workspace; if future API access becomes available, evaluate embedding automated video generation into internal documentation or training pipelines. This could streamline content creation for IT onboarding, troubleshooting guides, or internal newsletters without manual editing.

news.title: Gemini 3.8 text-to-speech says hello
news.summary: Google DeepMind unveiled Gemini 3.8, a new text‑to‑speech model that demonstrates natural, human‑like voice generation. The release expands the Gemini family’s multimodal capabilities, adding a high‑fidelity TTS engine that can be integrated into Google Cloud services.
news.enterprise_use: Evaluate whether Gemini 3.8 can be leveraged for automated voice‑based help desk scripts or user‑onboarding tutorials within your Google Workspace environment, as it may reduce manual content creation for support teams. If adopted, it could improve agent efficiency and enhance user experience, but ensure compliance with any privacy or data‑handling policies in your organization.

news.title: OpenAI’s latest features take direct aim at the app store model
news.summary_raw: OpenAI is building out the pieces of an alternative to the traditional app store model, turning ChatGPT into a place where software can be discovered and used by people and AI agents alike.
news.summary: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT into an app discovery platform, allowing users and AI agents to find and deploy software directly within the chat interface. The move signals a shift away from traditional app store ecosystems toward a unified, AI‑centric software marketplace.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Monitor OpenAI’s new ChatGPT app marketplace for any plugins that integrate with Google Workspace or JumpCloud. S2: Early adoption could streamline application provisioning for your team, but delayed engagement might mean missing out on native integrations that could reduce manual setup effort.

news.title: OpenAI repotedly in talks to raise $30B round at $1.4T valuation
news.summary_raw: The new round is anticipated to be the company's last before its delayed 2027 public debut.
news.summary: OpenAI is reportedly negotiating a $30 B funding round, valuing the company at $1.4 T. The infusion is expected to be the last before a delayed 2027 public debut.
news.enterprise_use: Keep this on the radar for future procurement discussions. A stronger OpenAI position could influence pricing or partnership terms for GPT APIs that your organization may integrate with Google Workspace or JumpCloud. Monitoring the funding round will help anticipate any shifts in API availability or cost structure within the next 90 days.

news.title: Here’s why OpenAI is absent from Nvidia’s industry-wide effort to end rogue AI agents
news.summary_raw: OpenAI isn't a public supporter of Nvidia's Open Agent Safety Platform, but it is privately working with Nvidia, TechCrunch has learned.
news.summary: OpenAI is not publicly backing Nvidia’s Open Agent Safety Platform but is reportedly collaborating with Nvidia behind the scenes to address rogue AI agents. The move signals a focus on AI safety infrastructure, though OpenAI’s engagement remains limited to private discussions.
news.enterprise_use: Watch for updates on Nvidia’s platform and any resulting security patches or best‑practice guidelines. While no immediate action is required, staying informed will help you evaluate whether to integrate or test such safety controls in your own environment in the coming months.

news.enterprise_use: Keep an eye on how GPT-6 Astra’s capabilities evolve, especially its potential for automating complex IT support tasks and generating code snippets. Monitoring its development will help you evaluate future integrations that could streamline ticketing, policy management, or scripting in tools like Freshservice and JumpCloud.

news.title: Introducing dots
news.summary_raw: Dots by OpenAI are a proactive assistant that can keep working across complex projects and everyday tasks. Learn how dots help you stay in control while work moves forward.

news.enterprise_use: S1: Evaluate Dots as a potential productivity enhancer for your team’s project management and support workflows. S2: It could reduce repetitive administrative tasks and improve response times, freeing IT staff to focus on infrastructure and security.

news.title: Introducing Quine: An AI research system designed for the complexity of biology
news.summary_raw:
Biology doesn't operate in silos, and neither should the AI representation of it. Quine is an early-stage research effort to create a multimodal world model of biology. By connecting insights across biological scales and modalities, Quine helps scientists computationally search a space far larger than intuition allows and prioritize hypotheses before they reach the lab. Experimental results provide important feedback, helping researchers sharpen future research directions.
The post Introducing Q
news.summary: Microsoft Research has unveiled Quine, an AI research system aimed at building a multimodal world model of biology. Quine integrates data across biological scales and modalities to enable computational hypothesis generation and prioritization for experimental validation.
news.enterprise_use: Keep Quine on your radar as a potential future collaborator for advanced biological data analytics, noting that it may open new avenues for integrating AI with life‑science workflows.

news.title: Offloaded inference for real-world physical AI robotics
news.summary_raw:
Robots are getting smarter, but how can their hardware match that growth? New Microsoft Research findings show that moving AI inference beyond the robot can improve task success, boost efficiency, and support more advanced physical AI workloads.
The post Offloaded inference for real-world physical AI robotics appeared first on Microsoft Research.
news.summary: Microsoft Research has demonstrated that offloading AI inference from robots to external processors can increase task success rates, improve efficiency, and enable more complex physical AI workloads.
news.enterprise_use: Keep an eye on how this approach might influence the design of future endpoint security or MDM solutions that integrate physical device intelligence. If your team is experimenting with IoT or edge computing, evaluate whether offloaded inference could reduce latency or resource usage on the devices you manage.

news.title: NVIDIA Kumo Tabular Sets a New Accuracy-Efficiency Frontier for Tabular Prediction
news.summary: NVIDIA’s Kumo Tabular delivers a new high‑accuracy, low‑latency model for tabular data predictions, outperforming existing open‑source solutions in both speed and precision. The model leverages advanced sparsity techniques to run efficiently on commodity GPUs, potentially reducing inference costs for data‑heavy workloads.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Explore integrating Kumo Tabular into your data processing pipelines to accelerate machine‑learning inference on existing GPU infrastructure. S2: This shift can lower operational expenses and improve model response times, which is critical for real‑time decision systems managed through tools like Google Workspace and Azure ML. S3: Prioritize testing in environments where tabular analytics feed into Freshservice ticketing or JumpCloud user‑behavior models, as improved accuracy may enhance predictive analytics without major architecture changes.
